review_locator: PMCID:PMC3491449, Interleukin-6, a Major Cytokine in the Central Nervous System; PMID:10695723, Interleukin-6 expression and regulation in astrocytes
primary_title: Interleukin-6 production by astrocytes: autocrine regulation by IL-6 and the soluble IL-6 receptor
decision_basis: The reviews identify TNF-alpha as an astrocyte IL-6 inducer; the cited primary attributes endogenous IL-6 protein production in astrocytes to TNF-alpha stimulation and measures IL-6 biological activity alongside transcript and transcriptional assays.
limitations_preserved: Extracellular IL-6 output only; preserve astrocyte culture and TNF/sIL-6R synergy context, keep IL-6 protein distinct from the existing TNF-to-IL6-gene row, and do not infer a receptor hop or SCI weighting.

primary_title: The selective anti-IL17A monoclonal antibody secukinumab (AIN457) attenuates IL17A-induced levels of IL6 in human astrocytes
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-17A as an astrocyte inflammatory cytokine inducer; the cited primary directly measures increased IL-6 protein in human astrocytes after IL-17A and inhibition by an IL-17A-neutralizing antibody.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4618768, Control of autoimmune CNS inflammation by astrocytes; PMID:10695723, Interleukin-6 expression and regulation in astrocytes
primary_title: The selective anti-IL17A monoclonal antibody secukinumab (AIN457) attenuates IL17A-induced levels of IL6 in human astrocytes
decision_basis: The reviews identify cooperative TNF-alpha and IL-17A astrocyte activation; the cited primary reports that TNF-alpha enhances the IL-17A-induced increase in IL-6 protein in human astrocytes and that blockade of IL-17A/NF-kappaB reduces the response.
limitations_preserved: Synergy/co-stimulation edge only; preserve the combined-input semantics and astrocyte context, do not split this row into an unsupported TNF-only effect, and do not infer SCI weighting.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4618768, Control of autoimmune CNS inflammation by astrocytes
primary_title: Regulation of CCL20 expression in astrocytes by IL-6 and IL-17
decision_basis: The review identifies IL-6 trans-signaling as an astrocyte inflammatory output route; the cited primary shows IL-6 plus soluble IL-6 receptor induces CCL20 expression with STAT3 binding to the CCL20 promoter.
limitations_preserved: Composite trans-signaling input is intentional; preserve IL-6 protein plus sIL-6R as the source, distinguish CCL20 gene from released CCL20, and do not infer IL-17A co-input or SCI weighting.

limitations_preserved: Composite trans-signaling input and extracellular output only; preserve IL-6 protein plus sIL-6R, keep release distinct from CCL20 gene induction and later CCR6 binding, and do not infer SCI weighting.
